description: This file declares the HealthcheckServiceFactory class, which implements the IHealthcheckServiceFactory interface. It provides a constructor to set the healthcheck interval and a method to create healthcheck service instances. The class is part of the rialto::servermanager::common namespace and manages the frequency of health checks.

classes.name: HealthcheckServiceFactory
classes.description: Implements the IHealthcheckServiceFactory interface, responsible for creating healthcheck service instances with a specified interval.

methods.name: HealthcheckServiceFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the healthcheck interval.

methods.name: createHealthcheckService
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of IHealthcheckService, configured with the healthcheck interval.
